questions.q: Why did Jim creep back up the bank instead of staying hidden under the bridge?
choices: His curiosity was stronger than his fear
He wanted to fight the pirates
He needed to fetch the pistol
His mother told him to go
questions.evidence: My curiosity, in a sense, was stronger than my fear

questions.q: Who was giving orders to the pirates who rushed the inn?
questions.evidence: the middle man of this trio was the blind beggar

questions.q: What was the blind man's name?
When Pew asks for "Flint's fist," what is he really looking for?
choices: Something written by Flint, not the money
questions.evidence: The blind man cursed the money.

questions.q: Whom did Pew blame when the pirates could not find what they wanted?
choices: The people of the inn, especially the boy
questions.evidence: It's these people of the inn--it's that boy.

questions.q: What did the whistle from the hillside turn out to be?
choices: A signal warning the pirates of approaching danger
Pew calling his crew to attack
The lugger signalling from the sea
questions.evidence: a signal to warn them of approaching danger

questions.q: Two pirates searched "half-heartedly" while the rest stood "irresolute on the road." What does "irresolute" mean?
questions.evidence: the rest stood irresolute on the road

questions.q: What did Pew do when his men argued that they already had the money?
choices: Struck at them with his stick
questions.evidence: he struck at them right and left in his blindness

questions.q: What happened to Pew when the horses and pistol-shot frightened the pirates away?

choices: He ran under a galloping horse and was trampled
He was shot by a revenue officer
questions.evidence: the four hoofs trampled and spurned him and passed by

questions.q: Who were most of the riders who arrived?
What happened when Supervisor Dance reached Kitt's Hole?
choices: The lugger was already sailing away and someone shot at him
He captured the lugger and its crew
He found the pirates asleep on the beach
questions.evidence: a bullet whistled close by his arm

questions.q: Why did Jim want to take the packet to Dr. Livesey?
choices: He believed it was what the pirates wanted and wanted it kept safe
He wanted to sell it to the doctor
The doctor had asked for it earlier
He thought it was medicine for his mother
questions.evidence: I believe I have the thing in my breast pocket
